S0.name: Baseline Ingestion
S0.description: Initial import of baseline procurement system and documentation.

conflicts.detail: Workbook manager threshold is 500,000 JPY while config and code execute 1,000,000 JPY.
Finance guide claims all >= 2M purchases need Finance review, while formal policy restricts this strictly to CAPEX.

gaps.detail: Emergency procedure is ambiguous about whether future general limit changes apply to emergency purchases.
2-business-day escalation is a manual document-only rule; no automated scheduler or holiday calendar exists.

S1.name: Manager Limit Reduced to 500k JPY
S1.description: Human decision reduces Manager approval threshold to 500,000 JPY across both Standard and Emergency processes.
S1.request_text: Reduce manager approval threshold to 500,000 JPY across all general and emergency purchases.

expected_actions.code_updated: app/emergency.py (emergency threshold parameterized or set to 500,000)

S2.name: Manager Limit Set to 750k JPY
S2.description: Subsequent human decision increases Manager approval threshold to 750,000 JPY.
S2.request_text: Adjust the manager approval threshold to 750,000 JPY.

S3.name: Source Content Restoration
S3.description: Reverting source repository files back to S0 baseline bytes.
S3.request_text: Restore source files to initial baseline state.

expected_actions.system_behavior: Ripple records forward revision event preserving historical human decisions; does not erase historical knowledge.

S4.name: External Excel Drift to 650k JPY
S4.description: External user or department updates approval_matrix.xlsx manager row to 650,000 JPY while system is on S1 (500k).

expected_findings.new_conflict: New value conflict detected: Excel states 650,000 JPY while operative config is 500,000 JPY.

S5.name: Finance Desk Guide Alignment
S5.description: Human decision clarifies and approves correcting finance desk guide to CAPEX-only.
S5.request_text: Update Finance Desk Guide to clarify that Finance sign-off applies strictly to CAPEX purchases of 2M JPY or higher.

expected_actions.docs_updated: docs/finance_desk_guide.md amended to specify CAPEX only.
